summary: RouteAccessGuard root-route fix VERIFIED. Bug fix confirmed: adding `/` to PUBLIC_EXACT_ROUTES in RouteAccessGuard.tsx eliminates the blocking 'Checking access' overlay on root URL. All 5 test cases passed: (1) visitor opening `/` no longer trapped behind overlay, (2) `/welcome` direct access works, (3) authenticated login flow works, (4) protected routes work after login, (5) public routes remain accessible for visitors.

test_1_root_url_visitor.description: Visitor opening root URL `/` should NOT show blocking overlay
test_1_root_url_visitor.evidence: No route-access-guard-overlay visible, URL correctly redirected to /welcome

test_2_welcome_direct.description: Visitor opening `/welcome` directly should NOT show blocking overlay
test_2_welcome_direct.evidence: No route-access-guard-overlay visible, welcome page content rendered

test_3_authenticated_login.description: Authenticated user can log in with free user credentials

test_4_protected_route_after_login.description: After login, navigating to protected route should work without blocking overlay
test_4_protected_route_after_login.evidence: Dashboard rendered successfully with sidebar and user content visible

test_5_regression_public_routes.description: Regression check - public routes still accessible for visitors after cookie clear

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: User reported blocking RouteAccessGuard overlay saying 'Checking access / Please wait while we prepare this page' on root URL `/`
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: RouteAccessGuard did not treat `/` as a public bootstrap route, causing false blocking overlay during auth bootstrap
bug_fix_verification.verification_method: Playwright browser automation on canonical preview host

critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly adds `/` to PUBLIC_EXACT_ROUTES set at line 14 of RouteAccessGuard.tsx
Public route bypass logic at lines 377-387 correctly checks all three path variants (bootstrapPathnameClean, normalizedPathnameClean, browserPathnameClean)
Auth bootstrap flow works correctly - session_renew_success logged after login
No regression in protected route behavior - dashboard accessible after login
context_for_next_testing_agent: RouteAccessGuard root-route fix verified. The bug where visitors were trapped behind 'Checking access' overlay on root URL `/` is now fixed. All public bootstrap routes (`/`, `/welcome`) work correctly for visitors. Authenticated login flow and protected route access work correctly. No regressions detected.
features_tested: Root URL `/` visitor access - PASS: no blocking overlay, redirects to /welcome
/welcome direct access - PASS: no blocking overlay, content visible
Authenticated login flow - PASS: credentials work, session established
Protected route /dashboard - PASS: accessible after login, no blocking overlay
Public route regression check - PASS: both `/` and `/welcome` accessible for visitors
